name: SuperBinah
description: SuperBinah is an AI solution-development studio. We find the use case worth building, prove it with a working POC, then ship it as a product your team actually uses.

approach.title: Point → Line → Plane
approach.intro: Our logo is our method. Every engagement grows the same way: from a single point of insight, to a proven line, to a product.

steps.label: 01 · Point
steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We find the one use case worth building and define how we will measure it.

steps.label: 02 · Line
steps.title: Prove
steps.text: A working proof of concept on your data, so you can decide with results in hand.

steps.label: 03 · Plane
steps.title: Build
steps.text: We ship it as a real product: integrated, secure and measured.

services.title: Discovery sprints
services.text: Find the use case worth building and agree what success looks like before anyone writes code.

services.title: Rapid POCs
services.text: A working proof of concept on your real data, so decisions run on evidence, not slides.

services.title: AI apps & agents
services.text: Production-grade assistants, agents and AI features, wired into the tools your team already uses.

services.title: Enablement
services.text: Hands-on workshops and a clean handover, so your team can run, extend and trust what we build.

meaning.title: Why “Binah”?
meaning.html: Binah (בינה) is Hebrew for understanding, and the word inside “AI”: בינה מלאכותית. In Kabbalah, Binah is where a raw flash of insight gets its shape and structure. That is our job: take the point of an idea and build it into something real.

cta.title:
Got an idea?
Let’s build the POC.
cta.text: Tell us about it. We will help you find the point, then prove it.

contact.title: Let’s find your point.
contact.text: Tell us about the idea. We will reply within two working days with a few questions and a time for a discovery call.
